title: Roller Coaster to School
caption:
Roller Coaster to School 🎢
You're riding a roller coaster to school. The hill is too low, you fly off at the turn, you're late. Every problem gets a fix, then a rocket launch shoots you through the school gate.

Would you ride it every morning? Comment below. Tag a friend who would. Follow @StickMindR8 for the next build.
